in_sanskrit.name: Hunny
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sweet Honey
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hunny एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the word 'madhu' which means 'honey', Hunny represents the sweetness and nourishment that life brings. In Hindu mythology, honey is a symbol of purity and healing.
